headline: Revenue growth accelerates; FY27 growth outlook raised!

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Mphasis (MPHLIM) CMP: ₹2,544 Target ₹ 3,000 (18%) Target Period: 12 months November 6, 2026 Revenue growth accelerates; FY27 growth outlook raised!
Q 2F Y2 7 performance : Mphasis reported revenues of US$486 mn, up 3.3% QoQ/9.7% YoY in CC terms.
The EBIT margin stood at 14.8%, flat QoQ and down 50 bps YoY.

Investment Rationale: • Improving growth visibility supported by healthy deal conversion : Mphasis delivered its strongest sequential growth in three years, with Direct Revenue increasing 3.5% QoQ and 11.3% YoY in CC terms.
valuation: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Mphasis (MPHLIM) CMP: ₹2,544 Target ₹ 3,000 (18%) Target Period: 12 months November 6, 2026 Revenue growth accelerates; FY27 growth outlook raised!
Management highlighted traction across BFSI, Insurance and Technology, with multiple live deployments and Tria influencing large-deal evaluations.

The platform is also enabling larger, multi-year transformation opportunities and reusable capabilities as deployments scale across clients, although revenue contribution remains too early to quantify Rating and Target Price : Given sustained resilient performance amidst uncertain macro environment, we maintain our BUY rating with a target price of ₹3,000 , valuing it at 22x FY28E EPS .
